load_tanks_and_temples_data: load Tanks and Temples dataset images, poses, bounds, and render poses from a basedir
create_spiral_render_poses: create spiral camera poses for novel view synthesis with configurable radii and focus depth
create_spherical_render_poses: create spherical camera poses orbiting a scene at a fixed radius and downward angle
spherify_poses: spherify input poses by centering, scaling, and generating circular render path poses
recenter_poses: recenter camera poses around their average position using the average pose as origin
